name: clientbooks-hub-mcp
description: ClientBooks Hub: multi-client MCP server for accountants, works with Xero. One practice login across many client orgs: cross-client data pulls, exception scans (unreconciled, duplicates, tax codes, variances), BAS/VAT and close readiness, month-end summaries, payroll risk, health scores and .xlsx packs. Read-only by default, opt-in DRAFT journals with two-step confirmation, local audit trail, rate-limited, tokens encrypted at rest.
author: Paris Piotis

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run test/integration.xero.test.ts
